notes.subject: הודו
notes.rationale: יָדָה i bin tok long 'tromwe samting', na bihain i tok long 'givim tenkyu / singautim nem' — Tok Pisin 'givim tenkyu' i holim pasin, tasol piksa bilong tromwe i lus.

notes.subject: ol wok bilong en
notes.rationale: עֲלִילוֹתָיו i tok long 'ol samting God i wokim' (strongpela wok) — 'wok' i liklik tumas, tasol i klostu.

notes.subject: ol man i ritim pes
notes.rationale: Tupela tok bilong tokim man: הודו קראו — pes i opim olgeta ol man long sekim nem bilong Yahwe.

translation: Givim tenkyu long Yahwe, kolim long nem bilong en, autim long ol lain olgeta ol wok bilong en.
